propositions: fsck detects three classes of dirty-tree artifacts: tracked deletions restorable from HEAD, untracked regenerable compaction leftovers, and orphaned .tmp-event-* files (informational only)
doctor --repair heals dirty-tree wedges non-destructively using two non-reentrant lock windows: file mutations (checkout/quarantine) under scoped write_lock, then reconverge self-locks after release
fsck reports each dirty-tree class via distinct JSON finding with count and paths; doctor repair creates backup ref before mutations and records all actions
repair safety contracts: no backup ref blocks all mutations and exits 1; failed checkout/quarantine marks unrepairable; class-3 files remain untouched and byte-identical
fsck dirty-tree classification uses NUL-terminated porcelain parsing to handle special characters; JSON path output is lossless via shlex quoting and declared-count boundaries
